text: 9月29日，国家发展改革委召开专题新闻发布会介绍推进服务业扩能提质有关情况。中国人民银行信贷市场司副司长车士义表示，近年来，为推动服务业加快发展，支持各类新兴业态、新服务场景融资，人民银行会同相关部门出台了一系列政策举措，着力完善金融产品和服务，促进加大高质量服务供给。截至今年二季度末，全国本外币服务业中长期贷款余额76.22万亿元，同比增长6.4%，增速比各项贷款高1.3个百分点，金融支持服务业发展取得明显成效。（证券时报）
text_en: On September 29, the National Development and Reform Commission held a special press conference to brief on progress in promoting the expansion and upgrading of the service sector. Che Shiyi, deputy director of the PBOC's Credit Market Department, said that in recent years, to promote accelerated development of the service sector and support financing for various new business forms and new service scenarios, the PBOC, together with relevant departments, has introduced a series of policy measures, focusing on improving financial products and services and promoting an increase in high-quality service supply. As of the end of the second quarter this year, the outstanding medium- and long-term loans in domestic and foreign currencies to the service sector nationwide stood at 76.22 trillion yuan, up 6.4% year on year, 1.3 percentage points higher than the growth rate of all loans, and financial support for the development of the service sector has achieved notable results. (Securities Times)
